items.title: Help Team Cayden get to safety!
items.summary:
Our 11-year-old son is autistic — and he is an artist.

He has been painting since he was two. He doesn't really draw.

He paints.

Creating is one of the most natural ways he expresses himself, and watching him grow into the young artist he is today has been one of the greatest joys of our lives.

But right now, our biggest concern isn't his art.

It's his future.

Why We're Leaving South Africa

We are a family of three and we are Afrikaners. South Africa is our home, and leaving is not a decision we've made lightly.

But the country's high levels of violent crime, growing insecurity and increasingly divided political and racial climate have left us deeply concerned about the environment our son will grow up in.

We don't want to wait until something happens to our family before deciding it is time to leave.

We want to make that decision while we still can — and give our son the opportunity to grow up somewhere we believe he can be safer and build his future.

We are working toward relocating to the United States.

Help Us Get There ❤️

We want to work, contribute and build our own future. We're not looking for a free ride or a luxurious new life.

But moving an entire family across the world requires a financial bridge.

We're raising funds to help us get through the next six months in South Africa, cover the costs of relocating, and give us some breathing room while we establish ourselves in the United States.

This will help with things like travel, relocation, temporary accommodation, transportation, deposits, healthcare and basic household necessities.

We're not asking you to give us a new life.

We're asking for help getting our family to a place where we can build one.

Every donation helps. And if you can't donate, sharing our story may be just as valuable.

Thank you for taking the time to hear our story, and for helping us give our son a chance at the future we're working so hard to build.

From our family to yours, thank you. ❤️

items.title: 8scribo
items.summary:
8scribo is a haiku minting platform. Every poem is stored on-chain and additional stored as a traditional NFT. 
We are online since June 2022 and 863 haikus have been minted so far!

This campaign should cover the infrastructure costs for the next 12 months, any surplus goes into an on-chain treasury toward next year.
